body.condition: For a sampled design \(S\neq\varnothing\) and an allocation \((n_c)_{c\in S}\in\mathbb N_{>0}^{S}\) satisfying \(\sum_{c\in S}n_c=N\), conditional on \(S\) and \((n_c)_{c\in S}\), \(Z\) is uniform over assignments satisfying \(\sum_{i\in\mathcal I}\mathbf1\{Z_i=c\}=n_c\) for every \(c\in S\).
